caption_note: Vanilla LoRA, InfLoRA and SD-LoRA use the available seed-0 classifier logs as explicitly requested; their endpoints are not matched to the earlier table. Their fixed-width illustrative bands are display aids, not estimates of variance or confidence. EWCLoRA and GAM-EWC+Merge use all included complete finite runs and retain empirical sample standard deviations. Training recipes differ across methods, so this is a descriptive historical comparison. GAM-EWC+Merge identifies the implementation traced from the old FS-EWCLoRA row. CIFAR GAM seeds 3 and 5 failed with NaN; DomainNet EWC seed 3 and ImageNet-R EWC seed 4 are incomplete; DomainNet EWC seed 4 did not start. CL-LoRA and BiLoRA are omitted as requested.
